lines.text: Short fighters don't lose to tall fighters.
Out here, his jab lands. Yours falls short.
Mike Tyson was five-ten. He knocked out forty-four men, most of them taller.
So how do you get inside?
One. Don't walk in straight. Step in on an angle.
Two. Move your head as you come in. Slip, then step.
Three. Once you're in, stay there. His long arms can't reach you.
Range isn't height. Range is a choice.
